svg.title: Turning columns back into rows
svg.desc: Eight column words of eight bytes are transposed in three rounds of interleaving, bytes then pairs then quads, until each row is eight contiguous bytes.
svg.text: Numbers are column indexes; colors are rows (r0 to r7).
8 column words (one per line), row 0 on the left:
round 1: zip bytes of columns 0 and 1
Each round doubles the runs of same-row bytes: 1, 2, 4, then 8.
